activeSlice.scope: Add shadow-only Hunter multi-stage intelligence: deterministic pre-rank, bounded candidate funnel, provider-neutral deep-analysis port, validated deep intelligence outputs and funnel diagnostics. Existing production Hunter ranking/persistence remains authoritative.
successCriteria: Pre-rank deterministically reduces trend candidates using Brand fit, topic fit, evidence, freshness, momentum, diversity and explicit penalties.
Unknown optional signals are excluded from the weighted denominator and reported explicitly rather than treated as zero.
Only a bounded top set may enter deep analysis; deep analysis is provided through an injected port and has no persistence authority.
Deep intelligence output validates mechanism, Brand interpretation, audience interpretation, gap analysis, actionable angle, originality, actionability and confidence.
Diagnostics expose funnel sizes, unknown-feature rates, deep-analysis success/failure and score distribution.
No provider credentials, scheduled execution, production Hunter wiring, UI changes, opportunity persistence or production enablement are introduced.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before certification.
